turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Could you send your order number (SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check whether the print can be returned for a refund.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.
I’ve passed your return and refund request for SC-3744 to a colleague, who will take over and let you know the next steps. The refund hasn’t been approved yet.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer claire.fontaine@example.com wants to return a print from SC-3744 for a refund because they ordered the wrong size. Return policy check returned allowed=false, reason large_refund. Please review and advise on next steps. No return request filed.
